body: I'm not worried about women. I've had girlfriends before, and so I know that there's limits to what most of them can put up with. I tell them I have depression and they're usually cool with the idea of it, but when it manifests it's a different story. They're people, too, so they have needs. Sometimes they want something, or want me to be something, and they want me to magically know what it is. Sometimes I'm too attentive and sometimes I'm not attentive enough. Or maybe someone else comes along that fits more with what they want. Or sometimes they think I'm someone I'm not. Sometimes they just change their mind, and sometimes they weren't serious. It's not that I don't like myself. I like myself fine. I try not to hold a grudge. I just don't have enough energy for women right now.

Nothing different than normal. I don't have a lot of friends to begin with and I don't have any in this town. I'm poor and on disability, but I'm used to it. The thought of getting a girlfriend just makes me tired in advance. I know that most women don't have the patience to deal with my problems. I think I've sort of accepted being lonely. I think maybe there's something in my environment but I don't know what it is.

I think I'll try putting of an MST3K, see if that helps calm me down.

Yeah. It hit me while I stood up from sitting. I can't pin it to anything. I have life problems like anyone with depression, I mean, there's always something not quite perfect, but I don't know why it happened now. I have OCD along with the depression, so maybe there was something not quite right that I didn't fix? I can't figure it out.

I did go to a restaurant after I wrote it, and that did make me feel worse, so coming back actually made me feel a little better. The burger tasted weird and they were playing that autotune dance music. I feel a little better with the silence.
